throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f8, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f9, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f10, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f11, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f12, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f13, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f14, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f15, $r4' --asm 'fdiv.s $f0, $f8, $f8; fdiv.s $f1, $f9, $f9; fdiv.s $f2, $f10, $f10; fdiv.s $f3, $f11, $f11; fdiv.s $f4, $f12, $f12; fdiv.s $f5, $f13, $f13; fdiv.s $f6, $f14, $f14; fdiv.s $f7, $f15, $f15'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent throughput: CPI 4.5 for special values; 5.5 for 1/1 and 1/2; 8.5 for general quotients; 8.0 for 1/max; 5.0 for max/minnorm; 9.0 for 1/maxsub. Throughput is initiation-interval bound.

notes: Latency 8-17 cycles and throughput CPI 4.5-9 are data-dependent; the stored experiments use representative operand samples.
